Russia strikes train line used by foreign leaders in Ukraine

Russia struck a railway line in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region on April 19, 2023, hitting an evacuated train. The attack occurred near the city of Synelnykove. The strike targeted a railway line used by foreign leaders, including an ex-CIA boss and a former British Prime Minister, according to reports. The train was carrying evacuated individuals at the time of the attack. The specific impact on foreign leaders' security was noted, though no casualties were detailed in relation to them.
